findings.reason: charts/templates/deployment.yaml:76-78 adds envFrom secretRef ms-secret-vault to every chart service; the new container in agent/ai-secure-agent.yaml has only an env list and no envFrom, and backend/ai-secure-agent-config.yaml has mysql username root with no password. On sync, the pod loses every Vault-injected variable.
findings.claim: New Deployment drops the envFrom ms-secret-vault secretRef the Helm chart applied, so the agent starts without Vault-held credentials (e.g. MySQL password).
findings.evidence: The deleted Helm release was rendered by `charts/templates/deployment.yaml:76-78`, which adds `envFrom: - secretRef: name: {{ .Values.externalSecret.targetName | default "ms-secret-vault" }}` to every service. The new container's `env:` (lines 25-35) sets only CONFIG_PATH, PYTHONUNBUFFERED, ENABLE_MLFLOW_TRACING, MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI and MALLOC_ARENA_MAX, and it has no `envFrom`. The mounted `backend/ai-secure-agent-config.yaml` has `mysql: username: "root"` but no password field. The repo's convention, stated in `backend/log-config.yaml:5-6` and `backend/mcp-server-config.yaml:6-7`, is that secrets are 'injected through the Vault external secret (ms-secret-vault)', and `k8s-configs/eos-microservice.yaml` creates that secret from `secret/ceramicraft`. Trigger: agent-app syncs this Deployment, the pod starts with no Vault-held variables, and its MySQL connection as root has no password.

members.claim: The new Deployment no longer gets the Vault-backed `ms-secret-vault` secret that the Helm chart gave it, so the agent will likely start without the MySQL password and any other credentials it reads from the environment.

findings.reason: app-of-apps.yaml:433 sets targetRevision to the feature branch, while every other in-repo source uses HEAD (lines 10, 77, 100, 111, 137, 272, 334, 388, 411). After merge, edits to agent/ on the default branch never deploy, and deleting the branch leaves the app with no source it can resolve.
findings.claim: agent-app tracks the feature branch AI-20-AISecureAgent-Feature-collection instead of HEAD, with automated prune/selfHeal.
findings.evidence: `targetRevision: AI-20-AISecureAgent-Feature-collection` with `syncPolicy.automated: prune: true, selfHeal: true` (lines 433-441). Every other Git-sourced Application and the helm-app ApplicationSet in this file use `targetRevision: HEAD` / `revision: HEAD` (lines 10, 77, 100, 111, 137, 272, 334, 388, 411). So once this change merges, the `helm_backend/ai-secure-agent-ms` removal takes effect from HEAD, while the replacement is read only from the feature branch.

findings.reason: The helm-app ApplicationSet (app-of-apps.yaml:97-125) generates an app per helm_backend/* on HEAD with prune on, and the chart names resources ai-secure-agent-ms / -svc, the same names agent/ai-secure-agent.yaml creates. app-of-apps.yaml is the only file defining Applications and nothing synced applies it, so the old release goes away on merge while agent-app only appears if someone applies the file by hand. Which Argo app acts first can't be read from the code, so this stays medium.
findings.claim: Deleting the Helm values removes the ApplicationSet-generated ai-secure-agent-ms app and its same-named resources, so the cutover risks deleting the replacement or causing an outage.
findings.evidence: The helm-app ApplicationSet generates one Application per `helm_backend/*` directory on HEAD (`app-of-apps.yaml:97-102`) with prune enabled. The chart names the objects `{{ .Release.Name }}` and `{{ .Release.Name }}-svc` (`charts/templates/deployment.yaml:4`, `service.yaml:4`), and the chart's default `hpa.enabled: true` (`charts/values.yaml:46-50`) adds HPA `ai-secure-agent-ms`, giving `ai-secure-agent-ms` and `ai-secure-agent-ms-svc`. The new manifest creates Deployment `ai-secure-agent-ms` and Service `ai-secure-agent-ms-svc` in `default` (`agent/ai-secure-agent.yaml:4,49`). `agent-app` exists only in the root `app-of-apps.yaml`, which no synced path applies, so the old release goes away automatically on merge but the replacement appears only when someone re-applies that file by hand.
